title: Settlement Basis: Instalments and Currency Conversion on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
An amount due on a booking sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands is settled in full at ticketing, or in instalments where the fare brand held admits an instalment plan and the booking value reaches the qualifying minimum for that brand. Where the traveller elects to be charged in a currency other than the ticketing currency, a markup of the percentage shown is determined on the amount converted and added to the converted total.

| Fare brand | Instalment plan | Minimum booking value qualifying for instalments | Currency conversion markup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | not available | 0.00 dollars | 3.50 percent |
| Economy Saver | available | 450.00 dollars | 3.50 percent |
| Economy Classic | available | 450.00 dollars | 3.00 percent |
| Economy Flex | available | 600.00 dollars | 3.00 percent |
| Premium Economy Select | available | 900.00 dollars | 2.50 percent |
| Business Saver | not available | 0.00 dollars | 2.00 percent |
| Business Flex | not available | 0.00 dollars | 1.50 percent |

Where an instalment plan is not available for the fare brand held, the qualifying minimum stands at 0.00 dollars and the whole amount is settled at ticketing.

Worked determination on hypothetical figures. A booking in Economy Flex of 560.00 dollars does not reach the qualifying minimum of 600.00 dollars for that brand and is settled in full at ticketing. A booking in Economy Flex of 720.00 dollars reaches that minimum and may be settled in instalments. If the traveller on that second booking elects a currency other than the ticketing currency, the markup determined is 3.00 percent of 720.00 dollars, that is 21.60 dollars, raised against the currency conversion line of that booking.

On the same hypothetical amount of 720.00 dollars the markup determined would be 25.20 dollars in Basic Economy Lite and in Economy Saver at 3.50 percent, 18.00 dollars in Premium Economy Select at 2.50 percent, 14.40 dollars in Business Saver at 2.00 percent and 10.80 dollars in Business Flex at 1.50 percent. A booking in Economy Classic reaches its qualifying minimum at 450.00 dollars, and one in Premium Economy Select at 900.00 dollars.
